## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally
- [ ] Routes have a permission policy and a matching nav entry
- [ ] Loading / empty / error / forbidden states handled
- [ ] Tests added for new behaviour
- [ ] Behaviour matches `docs/contracts/openapi.json`; gaps recorded in `docs/open-questions.md`
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in code, logs or fixtures
